parameters.name: AutoProvisioningGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the auto provisioning group. You can specify up to 20 IDs.

parameters.name: AutoProvisioningGroupName
parameters.description: The name of the auto provisioning group.

parameters.name: AutoProvisioningGroupStatus
parameters.description: The status of the auto provisioning group.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description:
The page number.

Pages start from page 1.

Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries per page.

Valid values: 1 to 100.

Default value: 10.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the auto provisioning group.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group to which the auto provisioning group belongs.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The tags that are added to the auto provisioning group.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ecs describe-auto-provisioning-groups --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --page-number 1 --page-size 2 --auto-provisioning-group-name testAutoProvisioningGroupName --resource-group-id rg-bp67acfmxazb4p0000 --auto-provisioning-group-id apg-sn54avj8htgvtyh80000 --auto-provisioning-group-status active --tag Value=TestValue Key=TestKey --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ecs DescribeAutoProvisioningGroups --region cn-hangzhou --Tag.1.Key TestKey --AutoProvisioningGroupName testAutoProvisioningGroupName --PageSize 2 --ResourceGroupId 'rg-bp67acfmxazb4p0000' --PageNumber 1 --Tag.1.Value TestValue --AutoProvisioningGroupStatus.1 active --AutoProvisioningGroupId.1 'apg-sn54avj8htgvtyh80000' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
